items.text: Build Virtual Worlds: Design and implement photorealistic, physically accurate simulation environments for locomotion, manipulation, and autonomous navigation using platforms like NVIDIA Isaac Sim/Isaac Lab, Mujoco or Drake.

3D Simulation Assets & Digital Twins: Create and manage high-fidelity 3D simulation assets (meshes, materials, collision geometry, articulation definitions, and virtual props) for digital twins of robot platforms and physical environments.

System Integration: Create clean APIs and interfaces to seamlessly connect simulation environments with AI/learning models (such as imitation learning or VLA policies), control systems, and robot operating stacks (ROS 2).
Bridge Sim-to-Real: Develop scalable sim-to-real pipelines, leveraging domain randomization, sensor noise modeling, and system identification to accelerate model training and policy validation.

Physical Fidelity: Collaborate with robotics hardware teams to ensure highly accurate modeling of kinematics, rigid-body/soft-body dynamics, actuators, and advanced sensors (LiDAR, depth cameras, force-torque sensors).
Scenario & Test Automation: Design and implement automated test suites, metrics-based evaluation pipelines, and complex scenario orchestration for benchmarking robot performance.

description.text:
The Delta Robotics Innovation Center (DRIC) is established to support Delta Electronics’ long-term robotics development. Its primary purpose is to build and enhance Delta’s capabilities in robot design, manufacturing, and integration. Rather than focusing on delivering specific products, the center aims to cultivate core competencies that enable Delta groups to efficiently develop and commercialize robotics-based solutions. We are looking for an engineer who bridges the gap between physics-based simulation, robust software engineering, and digital asset creation. This role is about creating the simulation infrastructure that enables faster, safer, and more efficient robotics development. You will build high-fidelity virtual environments and digital twins where robots can be trained, tested, and validated before deployment to real-world hardware.
Responsibilities
•Build Virtual Worlds: Design and implement photorealistic, physically accurate simulation environments for locomotion, manipulation, and autonomous navigation using platforms like NVIDIA Isaac Sim/Isaac Lab, Mujoco or Drake.
•3D Simulation Assets & Digital Twins: Create and manage high-fidelity 3D simulation assets (meshes, materials, collision geometry, articulation definitions, and virtual props) for digital twins of robot platforms and physical environments.
•System Integration: Create clean APIs and interfaces to seamlessly connect simulation environments with AI/learning models (such as imitation learning or VLA policies), control systems, and robot operating stacks (ROS 2).
•Bridge Sim-to-Real: Develop scalable sim-to-real pipelines, leveraging domain randomization, sensor noise modeling, and system identification to accelerate model training and policy validation.
•Physical Fidelity: Collaborate with robotics hardware teams to ensure highly accurate modeling of kinematics, rigid-body/soft-body dynamics, actuators, and advanced sensors (LiDAR, depth cameras, force-torque sensors).
•Scenario & Test Automation: Design and implement automated test suites, metrics-based evaluation pipelines, and complex scenario orchestration for benchmarking robot performance.

key_values.label: 其他條件
key_values.text:
Requirements
•Simulation Expertise: 2+ years of hands-on experience in robot simulation, digital twin development, or physics-based engine design.
•Software Engineering: Strong, production-grade programming skills in Python and C++, with solid familiarity with software design patterns in robotics systems.
•Robotics Foundations: Deep understanding of robot dynamics, kinematics, coordinate transforms, and sensor modeling.
•Frameworks: Practical experience working with ROS/ROS 2 and robot description formats (URDF/SRDF/USD).
•Sim-to-Real Experience: Practical knowledge of bridging the reality gap, including parameter tuning and domain randomization techniques.
•Plus: Experience with Simulation DevOps (Docker, cloud-based CI/CD pipelines) or Behavior Tree/state machine test scenario orchestration, with familiarity in 3D asset creation and optimization pipelines (Blender, OpenUSD).
